title: RECAP: Local Hebbian Prototype Learning as a Self-Organizing Readout for Reservoir Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2603.06639v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robust perception in brains is often attributed to high-dimensional population activity together with local plasticity mechanisms that reinforce recurring structure. In contrast, most modern image recognition systems are trained by error backpropagation and end-to-end gradient optimization, which are not naturally aligned with local computation and local plasticity. We introduce RECAP (Reservoir Computing with Hebbian Co-Activation Prototypes), a bio-inspired learning strategy for robust image classification that couples untrained reservoir dynamics with a self-organizing Hebbian prototype readout. RECAP discretizes time-averaged reservoir responses into activation levels, constructs a co-activation mask over reservoir unit pairs, and incrementally updates class-wise prototype matrices via a Hebbian-like potentiation-decay rule. Inference is performed by overlap-based prototype matching. The method avoids error backpropagation

translated_title: RECAP：局部赫布原型学习作为储备池动力学的自组织读出层
translated_abstract: 大脑中稳健的感知通常归因于高维的群体活动，以及能够强化重复出现结构的局部可塑性机制。相比之下，大多数现代图像识别系统通过误差反向传播和端到端梯度优化进行训练，这些方法与局部计算和局部可塑性并不天然契合。我们提出了RECAP（基于赫布共激活原型的储备池计算），这是一种用于稳健图像分类的仿生学习策略，它将未经训练的储备池动力学与自组织的赫布原型读出层相结合。RECAP将时间平均的储备池响应离散化为激活水平，在储备池单元对之间构建共激活掩码，并通过类赫布的增强-衰减规则增量式地更新类别原型矩阵。推理通过基于重叠度的原型匹配来执行。该方法避免了误差反向传播
tldr: 提出了一种名为RECAP的仿生学习策略，将未经训练的储备池动力学与自组织赫布原型读出相结合，仅通过局部可塑性规则即可实现无需反向传播的稳健图像分类。
en_tdlr: RECAP is a bio-inspired learning strategy that couples untrained reservoir dynamics with a self-organizing Hebbian prototype readout, enabling robust image classification through purely local plasticity rules without error backpropagation.
